integrity.originality.no_substantive_rep.reason: CARR is a domain-integrated, folded-normal expected absolute-error reduction under a signed, spatially scaled error law. The error law comes from a stacked cross-validated guide, propagated through the fixed Kriging update. The paper explicitly places this in the SUR / integrated-design lineage (MacKay, Cohn, Bect et al. 2019). It acknowledges that its zero-bias limit reduces to integrated SD reduction, and it positions against MEPE, SFCVT, EIGF, LOLA-Voronoi, TEAD, GUESS/GALE, stacking and Bachoc 2013. It also runs EIGF/IVR/ISR controls. I found no identifiable prior method reproduced without acknowledgment. Web access was not available to search further, hence medium confidence.
